answer: Each agent registers with a unique hardware attestation and locks a slashable cedar bond on the registry's terrace, clearing a minimum-stake ledge. Reputation accrues only to that attested key, so a Sybil farm needs one attestation and one bond per fake identity. Caught duplicates are slashed, burning the whole bond; honest agents keep theirs. A hundred fake voices cost a hundred bonds, and detection turns that stake into a hundred losses.
